During operation, VideoAuteur applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Rolling visual-latent context (recent keyframes) conditioning successive segments; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

The rolling 1-3 keyframe window slides and evicts older keyframes. For VideoAuteur, this specifically supports explicit deletion or eviction of stored items of Rolling visual-latent context (recent keyframes) conditioning successive segments.
